name: Arithmetic Problems
description: Solve 10 arithmetic problems (addition, subtraction, multiplication, integer division) per episode. Tests basic reasoning accuracy across all four operations.

binding_vow.description: The agent is shown 10 arithmetic problems one at a time and must provide the numeric answer to each. Problems cover all four operations. Division problems always yield whole-number answers.

action_space.description: Your numeric answer to the arithmetic problem shown in the observation.

reward.description: 1.0 if the answer matches the expected value exactly, 0.0 otherwise.
